limitations: Original authored benchmark fixture; not OEM dimensional compatibility or measured hardware. Only7mm retaining-ball diameter is manufacturer documented.

Groove profiles, gravity-biased axial ball race and sleeve locking land are engineered approximations preserving separate torque drive, radial ball retention, free axial play, automatic insertion and independent sleeve release.
Exact7mm sphere in both USD and supplemental CPU physics. No drilling, cutting, powered rotation, hammer action, grease flow or real dust seal is simulated.
